issues.description: The problem statement/UML specifies Rideable.messageOnRide() with no parameters, but the solution defines Rideable.messageOnRide(int speed) and implements it in Pig and Seal with an int parameter. This contradicts the provided Main example (which calls messageOnRide() without arguments) and will cause student implementations following the spec to be incompatible with the reference solution/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the Rideable contract across all artifacts. Recommended: change Rideable to `String messageOnRide();` and update Pig/Seal to implement `messageOnRide()` returning the specified string. If speed is intended, update the UML/text requirements and adjust the template Main and expected output format accordingly.

issues.description: The problem statement specifies the ride message format as exactly "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]", but the solution's Pig/Seal ride methods include additional speed text ("... at <speed> mph"). Even aside from the signature mismatch, this makes the required output unclear and can break output-based tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's ride message match the specified format (remove speed text), or update the specification to require the speed-inclusive format and document the exact expected string.
